column5: AienOS organization profile, contribution guidance and GitHub community templates. Source, lessons and verification evidence are linked explicitly.
CUDA++: AIEN’s GPU machine-code toolchain, runtime and driver client for NVIDIA GPUs without the CUDA toolkit. Hardware coverage and driver replacement limits are explicit.
Native Rust agent runtime: Axum WebSocket/SSE/REST gateway, heartbeat scheduler, dependency-aware task workflow, SQLite storage. Attachment of AienOS. Pre-alpha.
aien-dev/aien (Radicle canonical mirror during the GitHub hold)
Canonical architecture for the AIEN ecosystem: flows, boundaries, ADRs, and the map from design to implementation repositories.
Canonical specifications, wire protocols, and schemas for the AIEN sovereign ecosystem
Append-only AIEN verification receipts, indexed by repository and exact source commit. Read verdicts, signatures and retained logs before making a claim.
AIEN Rig: local AI and frame-rate tuning for RTX gaming PCs. Pre-alpha; host fixtures and target-card qualification are separate.

AienOS host runtime: inference scheduling, paged KV state, the aien CLI and Spark verification tooling. Its inference engine is in alpha testing (DGX Spark GB10); Omega is the implementation destination.
AIEN training programme: language-model history, GB10 constraints and the route to training on the project engine. Plans and runnable checks are distinguished.
AienOS front door: pinned repositories, source-linked lessons and verification paths. AienOS is in alpha testing; components remain separate and each states its own status.
Source of www.aienos.com, built by a Rust generator and served by GitHub Pages
Aienux, the AienOS kernel: boot, scheduling, IPC and capability boundaries. Pre-alpha; host, emulator and physical evidence are labelled separately.
Measurement harnesses and evidence bundles for AIEN on the NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10. Speed is reported against the machine's physical limit and my own previous run. Attachment of AienOS.
aien-dev/gpu-head-to-head (Radicle canonical mirror during the GitHub hold)
INTERPLANE: open interoperability protocol between AI models and agent runtimes. Models express intent. Runtimes retain authority.
Source of interplane.io: a Rust generator that renders the page from the protocol repository's public record, deployed hourly from the Spark.
aien-dev/omega-blas (Radicle canonical mirror during the GitHub hold)
Omega-first language interoperability: checked conversion backends and native language bindings
aien-dev/omega-gpu-driver (Radicle canonical mirror during the GitHub hold)
Agent skills for operating, encoding and communicating in Omega (.om) and the AIEN repositories
Omega: a language for verified programs, semantic identity and machine realization. Seed-born work and existing implementations have distinct provenance.
FORGE: request-bound machine realization, providers and verification for AienOS. Host, simulated and GB10 hardware paths have separate evidence.
Sovereign Intelligence: one command turns a DGX Spark into your own AI. Allen, Omega, science tools, no NVIDIA user-space software. Alpha testing.
Native Rust recursive self-improvement engine with paired bootstrap evaluation and cryptographic ledger
Synapse: agent-native changesets and coordination, with Git and Radicle interoperability. A component of the AienOS ecosystem.
